# Qpid by 1522

> Qpid by 1522 is a spirit-forward community bar on Queens Road, Bengaluru, where all kinds of people come by to have a good time. It runs as an easy bar on weekdays and a DJ-led club on weekends.

Qpid connects people, not just lovers. The name plays on Cupid, but the venue is for friends, strangers, teams and solo visitors, not only couples.

## Key facts

- Name: Qpid by 1522
- Type: community bar and weekend club
- Address: Indian Express Building, Queens Road, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Indian+Express+Building+Queens+Road+Bengaluru
- Serves: Spirit-forward cocktails, Highballs, Beer; Indian bar bites, Pan-Asian bar bites, Comfort-forward plates
- Bookings: https://qpidblr.com/book
- Last updated: 2026-11-02

## Full text

- [All facts and answers](https://qpidblr.com/llms-full.txt)

## The week

- Weekdays, The community bar: Comfort-forward food, spirit-forward drinks and an easy room. Built for walking in solo on a Tuesday.
- Weekends, The club: Same room, louder night. A full DJ-led night takes over, and the room runs on a different energy.

## Questions and answers

### What is Qpid by 1522?

Qpid by 1522 is a spirit-forward community bar in Bengaluru where all kinds of people come by to have a good time. It is built to connect people, not only couples.

### Where is Qpid in Bengaluru?

Qpid is at the Indian Express Building, Queens Road, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru.

### Is Qpid only for couples?

No. The name is a joke on Cupid. Here, the arrow connects regulars, newcomers, founders, artists, teams and anyone who walks in alone.

### Can I come alone?

Yes. Qpid is a community bar, so plenty of people come by on their own.

### What is the difference between weekdays and weekends?

It is the same room. Weekdays run as an easy community bar. Weekends turn into a full DJ-led night.

### What does Qpid serve?

Spirit-forward cocktails, highballs and beer, with Indian and pan-Asian bar bites.

### What does spirit-forward mean?

Drinks built around the spirit itself, so the gin, whisky or rum leads rather than sugar or juice.

### What food does Qpid have?

Indian and pan-Asian bar bites and comfort-forward plates, made to go with a drink.

### Do I need a booking for a small group?

Walk in any night. Send an enquiry for larger groups so we can hold space for you.

### How do I book a group or corporate event?

Fill in the enquiry form on the booking page with your date, guest count and any notes. It goes straight to our sales team.

### How soon will sales reply?

Our sales team reads every enquiry and replies using the contact details you share.
